tw: Kron sits reading on a reed, and the frog king needs to sing.
twc: Kron 坐在芦苇上读书，青蛙国王偏要唱歌。

tw: Kron's recorder records a parrot in the corner ordering four more corn cobs.
twc: Kron 的录音机录到角落里的鹦鹉在点四根玉米。

tw: Kron redirects diving ducks directly onto a wrecked deck, perfect!
twc: Kron 把俯冲的鸭子直接改道到一艘破船甲板上，完美！

tw: Kron's paint roller rolls over a mole's hole and rolls the mole yellow.
twc: Kron 的油漆滚筒滚过鼹鼠洞，把鼹鼠滚成了黄色。

tw: Kron drives round and round the roundabout, and a hound shouts, "Get out!"
twc: Kron 绕着环岛转了一圈又一圈，一只猎犬大喊：“出去！”

tw: Kron sees three seals feed on seaweed, and one sneezes weeds on him.
twc: Kron 看三只海豹吃海草，一只打喷嚏喷了他一身。

tw: Kron stacks ten Kron dolls on a shelf; an elf asks, "Which is your real self?"
twc: Kron 把十个自己的玩偶摆上架，小精灵问：“哪个是你自己？”

tw: The settler Kron sets his tent and kettle on a wet fishing net.
twc: 开拓者 Kron 把帐篷和水壶全架在一张湿渔网上。

tw: Kron knits a tiny sock to block the socket from shocks.
twc: Kron 给插座织了只小袜子，挡住电击。

tw: Kron sails southeast, and a beast with a big mouth eats his feast.
twc: Kron 往东南航行，一头大嘴怪兽吃掉了他的大餐。

tw: Kron rides out southwest, then rests in an eagle's nest with his mouth open.
twc: Kron 骑马一路往西南，最后张着嘴睡进了老鹰窝。

tw: Kron the taxpayer pays his tax today in stacks and stacks of hay.
twc: 纳税人 Kron 今天交税，交的是一捆又一捆干草。

tw: Kron's thirst is the worst, so he drinks first from a burst hose.
twc: Kron 渴得要命，抢先对着爆开的水管喝。

tw: Kron sings higher and higher, and the whole choir begins to tire.
twc: Kron 越唱越高，整个合唱团都唱累了。

tw: Kron rides a board toward the shore, and a walrus roars, "Forward!"
twc: Kron 踩着冲浪板冲向岸边，海象大吼：“冲啊！”

tw: Kron uses giant pliers to pull a tyre out of the dryer.
twc: Kron 拿大钳子把轮胎从烘干机里拽出来。

tw: Kron's pup blows up a bubble and floats upward like a bird.
twc: Kron 的小狗吹了个泡泡，像鸟一样往上飘。

tw: Kron buys used shoes at the zoo, and a confused moose wants them back.
twc: Kron 在动物园买了双旧鞋，一头驼鹿想要回去。

tw: Kron, a new user, uses a computer mouse, and a real mouse moves the cursor.
twc: 新用户 Kron 用电脑鼠标，一只真老鼠在挪光标。

tw: A squirrel guest packs Kron's best vest full of nuts, up to his chest.
twc: 松鼠客人往 Kron 最好的背心里塞坚果，塞到胸口。
